name: entropy_map
description: Shannon entropy across a file in windows, so packed, compressed or encrypted regions show up before anything is disassembled. Returns the profile, the high-entropy runs with their offsets, and the overall figure.

threshold.description: Bits per byte above which a window counts as high (default 7.2)

max_windows.description: Inline preview rows when OUT can hold the complete entropy-windows.tsv (default 256); ignored when no lossless output directory exists
